scripts.hook-errors: echo '\x1b[31mThe build failed lint checks. See the eslint output above for details.\n' && exit 1
scripts.test:all: npm test && npm run test:panel && npm run test:watcher
scripts.typecheck:all: npm run typecheck && npm --prefix static/panel run typecheck && npm --prefix static/attachment-watcher run typecheck
scripts.build:ui: npm --prefix static/panel run build && npm --prefix static/attachment-watcher run build
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck:all && npm run lint && npm run test:all && npm run build:ui
